papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Control for Smooth and Accurate Circular Trajectory Tracking in Mobile Robots
papers.summary: This paper investigates reinforcement learning-based control for smooth and accurate trajectory tracking of a nonholonomic mobile robot. Three reinforcement learning algorithms, Deep Q-Network (DQN), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), are implemented and evaluated, with conventional PID and Sliding Mode Control (SMC) controllers included as comparative baselines. The robot is modeled using unicycle kinematics, and the tracking task is formulated through body-frame longitudinal, lateral, and heading errors. papers.title: Active Microrobotic Sampling for Embodied Biological Digital Twins at the Limit STARLI Research Works Institute XXVIII Extension 06 English Description This high-density research monograph turns the biological digital twin from a passive recipient of measurements into an embodied experimental partner. Competing twins use uncertainty, expected information gain, physical reachability, safety, authorization, assay burden and traceability to propose the next microrobotic sampling location, time and analyte. The twin remains a versioned scientific belief rather than a replica of a patient, tissue or living system. Central Contribution The Active Sampling Evidence Charter binds twin ancestry, candidate and rejected actions, expected information gain, safety calculations, authorization state, robot trajectory, quantum and classical raw measurements, structured residuals, model forks, resets, abstentions and human overrides into one replayable evidence object. A quantum measurement qualifies only when it reduces biological sampling burden or improves mechanism discrimination against the best classical readout. papers.title: Time integration of quantized tensor trains using the interpolative dynamical low-rank approximation
papers.summary: Quantized tensor trains (QTTs) are a low-rank and multiscale framework that allows for efficient approximation and manipulation of multi-dimensional, high resolution data. One area of active research is their use in the numerical simulation of hyperbolic systems such as the Navier–Stokes equations and the Vlasov equations. papers.summary: ABSTRACT Background Robotic‐assisted unicompartmental knee arthroplasty (rUKA) aims to enhance the precision and reproducibility of implant positioning compared with manual UKA (mUKA). papers.summary: While robotic-assisted thoracoscopic surgery offers some advantages over open surgery, the minimally invasive management of intraoperative bleeding has some limitations, which can necessitate open conversion. Pure and Hybrid Theories of Desire
papers.summary: Desire has close causal relations to many mental states and events. These include the motivation of action, hedonic feelings of pleasure and displeasure, and reward as characterized by theories of reinforcement learning. Which are necessary and sufficient for desire, and which does it have only contingently? Pure theories suggest only one of these, while hybrid theories suggest more than one. papers.summary: Face Mood Detection Using Artificial Intelligence is a web-based application developed to recognize human emotions from facial expressions using Artificial Intelligence (AI), Deep Learning and Computer Vision techniques.
